items.title: Automated Social Content Pipeline
items.description: An event triggers the whole chain: an automatic email update and feedback request go out, then the system drafts posts for LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and Facebook based on what happened. Real-time feedback feeds back into the drafts, a manual pass adds likes and comments, and a stats page tracks everything that went out and how it performed.

items.title: Personal Voice Writer
items.description: Learns how a specific person writes, then generates LinkedIn posts in that voice — personal updates, industry commentary, and company announcements — so the output sounds like them, not a template.
